'''Hydraulic actuators''' were components on [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]]. They were used by the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter's]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], alongside [[remote servo]]s, to enact repairs during flight.<ref name="SWS" />
